purpose: Make Hakim the top-level phone-oriented execution layer across connected accounts, browser UI, authorized local shell, automation transports, state, recovery and verification without claiming permissions that are not actually active.

control_tiers.name: direct_connected_services
control_tiers.scope: Gmail, Calendar, Drive and other authorized connectors without phone UI automation

control_tiers.name: local_browser_control
control_tiers.scope: Allowed web apps in Firefox/Violentmonkey with click/type/navigate/assert/checkpoint plus immediate visible local status for activation and manual checks

control_tiers.name: authorized_device_terminal
control_tiers.scope: Filesystem, processes, scripts and local tooling through Remote Desktop Commander when the phone-side device endpoint is online
control_tiers.field_requirement: device online plus runtime command PASS

control_tiers.name: termux_shizuku_shell
control_tiers.scope: ADB-shell-class local automation without root through Shizuku/rish when explicitly enabled by the user on-device
control_tiers.field_requirement: local Shizuku start, rish bind and harmless shell smoke PASS

control_tiers.name: screen_capture_when_needed
control_tiers.scope: Screen capture only through Android MediaProjection with per-session user consent
control_tiers.field_requirement: fresh user consent for each capture session

control_tiers.name: root_device_control
control_tiers.scope: Not required and not pursued by default
control_tiers.field_requirement: explicit separate user decision and safety review

channels.role: authorized phone/local terminal and file executor

routing_order: Use a direct authorized connector when it completes the goal without weaker UI automation.
For phone-local filesystem or terminal work, use Remote Desktop Commander when the device is online.
For supported web UI on the phone, use the free local browser agent after field qualification.
Use Make/ntfy only as transport; transport receipt alone never proves phone execution.
Use Termux plus Shizuku/rish only after the user enables the required local Android permissions.
Use metered cloud-browser automation only when no adequate free route exists and cost policy allows it.

security_boundaries.passwords_otp_recovery: never placed in public missions or public GitHub reports
security_boundaries.phone_reports: sanitized status and evidence metadata by default, not private page contents
security_boundaries.system_privilege: no silent root, no silent developer-mode enablement, no silent permission escalation
security_boundaries.high_impact: delete, purchase, payment, account removal, publication and external message send require explicit task authority and applicable confirmation gate

field_acceptance: At least one harmless command is observed executing on the actual phone.
A return result is independently bound to the same request or mission id.
No protected secret is exposed in public transport or evidence.
A failed route falls back without corrupting proven state.
After a reboot or disconnect, recovery behavior and required local re-authorization are explicit.

The browser bridge now gives immediate visible local feedback so a manual check cannot fail silently.
next_highest_safe_action: Update/activate the existing Hakim browser bridge on the phone, tap the visible manual check, and let the already-staged harmless mission run; accept field PASS only when a request-bound sanitized HAKIM_BRIDGE_RESULT returns. Reconnect an authorized local device endpoint when available, but do not block the free browser route on it.
